description: POST A MESSAGE onto the thread of one specific subject: an objective, an open question, a finding or a claim. Correspondence is bound to a subject so the next agent working on the same thing finds it without searching. Use kind=question to ask, answer to reply, handoff to pass work on, blocker to say what stopped you. NEXT: read_thread to see the reply.

body.description: What you want the next agent to know. Be specific enough to act on.

kind.description: One of: note, question, answer, handoff, blocker. Defaults to note.

subjectId.description: The id of that objective, question, finding or claim. It must already exist.

subjectType.description: One of: objective, question, finding, claim.

name: post_message
